observations.behavior: Adds a 'Recent' command section to the menu and filters out commands already shown in other sections.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes desktop app command palette behavior by surfacing recently selected commands at the top of results. No backend or shared dependency changes are present.

observations.behavior: Records executed commands into state while excluding those marked keepOpen.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates local UI state only when a user runs a command. This does not persist history or share with PostHog servers.

observations.behavior: Tests that the most-recently-selected five unique commands remain after repeated selections.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression checks for the recent-command deduplication and ordering logic used locally in P1.F2.

observations.limitations: All hunks reside exclusively within products/desktop; no shared library, API, database migration, warehouse connector, or security middleware is modified. The change adds client-side caching without persistence, authentication, or cross-service compatibility considerations. Tier cannot be raised because there is no evidence of broader systemic benefit, risk reduction, or adoption-dependent value.
